scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.debug: cd frontend; npm install && npm run build -- --mode development && cd ../backend; npm install && npm run debug
scripts.dev: cd frontend; npm install && npm run build -- --mode development && cd ../backend; npm install && npm start
scripts.frontend: cd frontend; npm install && npm start
scripts.backend: cd backend; npm install && npm start
scripts.backend-dev: cd backend; npm install && npm start
scripts.backend-debug: cd backend; npm install && npm run debug
scripts.setup: npm ci && npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend && git submodule update --init --recursive
